test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In an audio launching program, some anchors are sitting in a row facing north. Archana is sitting fourth to the left of Chitra and seventh to the left of Bhumika. Bhumika is sitting fifth to the left of Darani. There is only one anchor between Darani and Eesha. There is no anchor sitting to the right of Eesha. If there is no other anchor sitting in the row, then how many anchors are sitting in total?
solution:
Given: In an audio launching program, some anchors are sitting in a row facing north.

1) Archana is sitting fourth to the left of Chitra and seventh to the left of Bhumika.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1bb41eb94209624124d3e6308d04e4a1e21567648ebba893978d3f69e3806be.png] 

2) Bhumika is sitting fifth to the left of Darani.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1deca98963f8e089eed96e40ea772c97c9a34b0d4f2926bf13f150d45a0bdc5.png] 

3) There is only one anchor between Darani and Eesha.

4) There is no anchor sitting to the right of Eesha.

Thus final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a24b3947eeeda71c94edbc1319cb77a5bf128a00e9c9288f82216fcca8c57535.png] 

If there is no other anchor sitting in the row, then **15 **anchors are sitting in total.

Hence, the correct answer is **"15".**
